entities.name: AWS
entities.rationale: Represents the public cloud data sources; visually represented by a green cloud icon labeled AWS.

entities.name: ON-PREM
entities.rationale: Represents on-premises data sources; visually represented by a computer monitor icon labeled ON-PREM.

entities.name: APACHE METRON
entities.rationale: Compute engine running Apache Metron for real-time ingestion, parsing, and enrichment; visually represented by an orange compute icon.

entities.name: EMR
entities.rationale: EMR cluster used to transform persistent data; drawn inside the dashed 'Security Data Lake' container.

entities.name: S3
entities.rationale: Storage layer for telemetry data; drawn inside the dashed 'Security Data Lake' container.

entities.name: ATHENA
entities.rationale: Interactive query service for log analytics and mining; drawn inside the dashed 'Security Data Lake' container.

entities.name: SOAR
entities.rationale: Security Orchestration, Automation, and Response platform (Blitz); visually represented by an orange compute icon labeled SOAR.

entities.name: ALERTS
entities.rationale: SOC analysts receiving triage alerts; visually represented by a user group icon labeled ALERTS.

entities.name: WAF
entities.rationale: Web Application Firewall used for automated threat mitigation; visually represented by an orange icon labeled WAF.

visual_connections.description: Public cloud telemetry events are pulled into Apache Metron.
On-premises logs are ingested into Apache Metron via syslog or Kafka.
Persistent telemetry events from Apache Metron are picked up by an EMR job.
EMR transforms and writes persistent telemetry data to S3.
Athena runs SQL queries and analytics on data stored in S3.
Long-term profiled models from the Security Data Lake feed back into Apache Metron for enrichment.
Metron forwards detection alerts to the SOAR framework.
Enriched alerts are presented to SOC analysts for investigation.
Analysts execute response actions and blocking rules via WAF.
